content.text:
Image 1: Ten-panel storyboard reference, used for the overall shot structure, shot sizes, and camera-movement rhythm. Read it from left to right and from top to bottom; panel N is Shot N. It is a line-art sketch: do not adopt its sketch style, black outlines, white background, panel borders or drawn faces.
Image 2: Reference of Sebastian's apartment, living room, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, a rendered set, not live action. Use it only for the room's layout, the furniture's positions and the light's direction; do not reference its visual content. It contains no people.
Image 3: Reference of Sebastian's apartment, living room, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, a rendered set, used only for the room's layout; it contains no people.
Image 4: Reference of Sebastian's apartment, living room, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, a rendered set, used only for the room's layout; it contains no people.
Image 5: Reference of Sebastian's apartment, living room, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, a rendered set, used only for the room's layout; it contains no people.
Image 6: Reference of Sebastian's apartment, living room, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, a rendered set, used only for the room's layout; it contains no people.
Image 7: Blocking reference of the segment's start: the same place with these people in their places, used only for where each person is and which way they face; take faces and outfits from each subject's own image. It is a line-art diagram: do not adopt its outlines or white background.
Image 8: Subject 1 (Natalie, look S1) character appearance reference.
Image 9: Subject 2 (Sebastian, look S2) character appearance reference.
Image 10: Prop 1 (agreement) maps to this image; use only structure, material, and color, and copy its writing and badges exactly from Image 10.
Image 11: Prop 2 (bag) maps to this image; use only structure, material, and color, and copy its writing and badges exactly from Image 11.
Image 12: Prop 3 (lace bra) maps to this image; use only structure, material, and color, and copy its writing and badges exactly from Image 12.
Image 13: Prop 4 (pillow) maps to this image; use only structure, material, and color, and copy its writing and badges exactly from Image 13.
[Subject settings]
Subject 1 (Natalie): Refer to Image 8. 25, the heroine; George's daughter from his first marriage, who agrees to marry Sebastian Klein to pay for her mother's dialysis. Outfit: look S1: An elegant, figure-fitted ivory-white satin bridal gown with thin spaghetti straps and a low sweetheart neckline. The sculpted bodice is fitted, and the skirt hugs her hips before flaring softly into a floor-length hem. A narrow pale-blue satin sash, her 'something blue', cinches the waist. A short sheer tulle veil is pinned at the back of her curls. Ivory satin pointed-toe heels. No jewellery. Signature colour: blue.
Subject 2 (Sebastian): Refer to Image 9. 30, the hero; the scorned illegitimate son of the Klein family, jailed for three days for reckless driving and secretly a billionaire running a plan. Outfit: look S2: A black slim-cut tuxedo jacket with satin lapels, a crisp white dress shirt, a black bow tie, black tuxedo trousers, black patent oxfords, a small white rose boutonnière and the steel-and-black wristwatch. Signature colour: black.
Environment (Sebastian's apartment, living room): Refer to Images 2 to 6. Night, warm lamplight indoors, city lights glowing through the window. Warm arc floor lamp at the couch's front-door end and the pendant over the dining table; city lights through the window. Quiet room tone.
Do not swap the characters' appearances, clothing, actions, positions or dialogue.
[Subjects and relationships]
Only two people appear throughout: Natalie and Sebastian.
[Blocking]
Refer to Images 2 to 6 for the room and Image 7 for the people's places. Natalie sits at the kitchenette end of the couch in her bridal gown, leaning over the round coffee table with the blue pen over the written agreement; her pale-blue bag stands on the floor at the kitchenette end of the couch. Sebastian, in his tuxedo, stands on the window side of the coffee table, facing her. The white pillow lies on the dining chair nearer the couch.
[Overall style]
Photorealistic live-action short drama with cinematic lighting. Each character keeps the face and the outfit with its main colour from their reference image throughout. Use each character sheet only for that character: the face from the close-up on the right, the body and outfit from the turnaround on the left; do not render the sheet's layout, white background or multiple views. This segment has 3 lines, in this order: Sebastian, Sebastian, Natalie. Generate speech only from the lines in {} in the shot list, each spoken exactly once by its speaker; everyone else keeps their mouth naturally closed while listening, and a V.O. speaker keeps their mouth closed or is off screen. Follow the shot list below; do not add cuts or camera moves beyond it. Strictly adhere to the 180-degree rule: within a scene, characters keep their screen sides and the camera stays on one side of the axis. Seamless continuity of action, spatial matching and consistent actor blocking; cut on action. For dialogue prefer static shot-reverse-shot and over-the-shoulder shots, balanced with reaction shots and close-up inserts. Faces stable and clear, consistent with the reference images, with no resemblance to any real actor or actress. Normal human eyes. Natural anatomy and hands. Natural, fluid motion that follows the blocking; characters make subtle, natural movements. Characters, props and environment share one world with matched lighting. Each line ends naturally with breathing room and is never cut off. Authentic performances with micro-expressions. No BGM; generate only dialogue, environmental sounds and action sounds. No subtitles.
[Continuity]
Maintain continuity in the identities, number, appearance, clothing, relative heights, spatial positions, and eyelines of all the characters. The actions in the shot list occur strictly in sequence. Hands are anatomically correct.
[Strictly exclude]
added or missing characters, spatial jumps. nudity or revealing clothing. malformed hands. Dialogue from the wrong character, multiple people speaking at once, repeated or missing lines, lip-sync errors and audio-visual desynchronization. The raw reference images (character sheets, setting plates) appearing as a frame of the video, and starting on a still frame of the setting reference. A fast zoom-in at the start, a fast pull-back at the end, unmotivated whip-pans, tilts, zooms and 360-degree orbits. Axis-crossing, jump cuts, frame skips, flicker and clipping. Face swaps, changes in age or clothing, sudden height shifts, added or missing characters, spatial jumps, and disordered action sequences; props popping in or vanishing, and duplicate characters except mirror reflections. Hand clipping, extra fingers, fused fingers, malformed hands. Subtitles, captions, watermarks and garbled writing; writing and logos other than those on a key prop's reference image, which are copied from it; a phone screen or paper that is not a key prop is shown from the back or out of focus. Black-and-white, monochrome, grayscale, desaturated visuals; hand-drawn, sketch, line art, illustration, comics, animation; storyboard frames, rough sketches, panel borders, gutters and grid layouts.
[Shot list] (10 shots, approximately 23 seconds)
When a previous-shot reference image is given, it is the moment this segment starts from: keep its people's positions, outfits, props and light, and continue from there. Shot 1 keeps its own camera, matching the image's framing only when it frames the same view; do not repeat that frame later.
Shot 1 (0-3s): [Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot past Natalie on the couch, eye-level on Sebastian] Sebastian holds up two fingers, then lowers his hand to the coffee table. Dialogue (Sebastian, in English, easy, generous): {Both of them. You won't owe a cent.}
Shot 2 (3-5s): [Close-up insert, high angle, on the agreement on the coffee table] Natalie's hand signs her name at the bottom of the handwritten agreement. <Pen scratches>
Shot 3 (5-7s): [Medium shot, eye-level, both in profile across the coffee table] Sebastian takes the pen from Natalie, bends over the coffee table and signs beneath her name while she watches. <Pen scratches>
Shot 4 (7-9s): [Medium shot, low angle, on Natalie at the kitchenette end of the couch] Natalie lifts her unfastened pale-blue bag from the floor and sets it on the coffee table, its top gaping open. <Leather bag thuds onto wood>
Shot 5 (9-11s): [Close-up insert, high angle, on the coffee table] A folded pale-blush lace bra slips out of the open bag and lands on the signed agreement.
Shot 6 (11-13s): [Medium close-up, eye-level, on Natalie leaning over the table] Natalie, cheeks flushing, quickly scoops the lace bra back into her bag.
Shot 7 (13-15s): [Medium shot, locked-off, eye-level, on Sebastian across the coffee table] Sebastian raises one eyebrow with a slow, amused smile. Dialogue (Sebastian, in English, teasing murmur): {New clause?}
Shot 8 (15-17s): [Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot past Sebastian, eye-level on Natalie] Natalie clutches the bag shut against her and gives him a sharp look. Dialogue (Natalie, in English, flustered but firm): {No. And not an invitation.}
Shot 9 (17-20s): [Medium shot, pan following Sebastian from the coffee table to the dining chair and back, eye-level] Sebastian picks up the white pillow from the dining chair nearer the couch and drops it onto the front-door end of the couch. <Soft thump of the pillow>
Shot 10 (20-23s): [Wide shot, locked-off, eye-level, from the kitchenette side; bedroom door at frame right] Natalie rises with her bag and walks into the bedroom, leaving the door half closed behind her. Sebastian now stands at the kitchenette end of the couch, watching the door. The signed agreement and the pen stay on the coffee table. <Bare footsteps fade, the door swings>
At the end: Natalie is inside the bedroom with her bag, behind the half-closed bedroom door on the back wall. Sebastian, in his tuxedo, stands at the kitchenette end of the couch. The white pillow lies at the front-door end of the couch; the signed agreement and the blue pen lie on the round coffee table.

<Image 14> is the previous shot (seg01/t02 at 27.94s).
